label: SHARED_START_REFINEMENT_DEVELOPMENT_PILOT_PROPOSED
algorithm: Freeze source/schema/approved scope/settings/model template and generator request.
Make one generation request per requirement; seal exact raw response, extracted full candidate/version/hash and usage.
Single-shot view is that one preserved delivery; no check/review/repair feedback changes it.
NLTL starts from the exact same raw response/candidate, empty prior issues, source-only evidence and the same technical/review criteria. No second initial generation and no historical seed/solution.

At most one repair, two candidates including the shared initial; four primary reviews total, three per candidate, one shared correction per review, two retrieval rounds; at most10 physical calls including shared generation per requirement.

Close dispatch and seal candidate/selection manifests before independent evaluation. Report accepted-only and proposed technically-valid-delivery views separately without changing controller behavior.
physical_call_formula: 5 * (1 shared generation + 1 repair + 4 primary reviews + 4 shared corrections)
not_comparable_as_same_design: Earlier pilot used10 independent generations: identical requests do not mean identical starts. Shared-start estimates incremental refinement conditioned on one sampled start, not independent-workflow superiority.
cost_and_time: Attribute shared generation to each logical arm, but count it only once in physical total. Single-shot finishes at first delivery; NLTL workflow includes that same initial latency plus refinement. No model/seed reruns chosen by result.
implementation_readiness: Design only. Current Runner.run/CLI independently generates; launching both ordinary CLIs would NOT implement shared-start. A future small orchestrator must hand the one fresh raw/candidate artifact to existing assess_candidate/review/repair routes, or explicitly record cached initial delivery, with shared_call_id and physical versus logical accounting. No historical continuation driver, new framework or wrapper is installed now.
